behavior: The whole site has a dark theme: a toggle in the nav, the system preference by default, the choice remembered, and no flash of the wrong theme
acceptance: Given no saved choice and a dark system preference, when / loads, then <html> has data-theme=dark before first paint; with a light preference it is light
Given the nav theme toggle, when clicked, then the theme switches, and after a reload the chosen theme stays
Given the dark theme, then the hero uses a night version of the landscape with readable light text, and every section, the footer art and the call to action use dark-theme colors
Given / and /kit in the dark theme, when axe runs, then there are 0 serious or critical violations
notes: 2026-10-08 review pass by subagent: PASS. Tests: playwright landing+a11y+kit+waitlist 40/40 passed (incl. dark: head script before <body>, dark/light system pref, toggle+reload persists, night hero img visible with text contrast >=4.5 at 1440/390, axe 0 serious/critical on / and /kit in both themes); design-tokens 63/63, ui-web 14/14, web 16/16; pnpm lint and typecheck clean. Screenshots: dark hero uses hero-night.webp with same composition, river path and 4 marks sit on the moonlit water (desktop and 390 mobile), headline/subhead/beta note readable; nav toggle shows Sun in dark, Moon in light; every section (networks strip, steps, profiles tabs/card, rules list, API code block, withdrawal quote, FAQ, CTA, footer) has dark surfaces, readable text, visible borders; checkout band keeps the dusk image in a rounded frame and stays distinct; CTA halftone dots are dark teal (--fw-art-dot #2f5f73); kit dark shows all tokens incl. new art-* swatches; light screenshots match previous look. Security: THEME_INIT_SCRIPT (packages/design-tokens/src/constants/themes.ts:16) is a compile-time constant that interpolates only THEME_STORAGE_KEY; no user input reaches dangerouslySetInnerHTML (apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx:38). No-flash proof adequate: script is a sync inline <script> in <head>, ThemeSwitch never sets the attribute on mount and the server renders data-theme=light, so data-theme=dark under an emulated dark preference can only come from the head script, which runs before body parse. Non-blocking notes: (1) footer-ridges.tsx grain filter lightens the far ridge to ~#32383b grey (token #1d2a33 at 0.7) because noise passes through where layer opacity <1; still reads dark. (2) hero-journey.tsx: priority stays on the dawn image, so dark visitors preload the unused dawn image and the night image (the dark LCP) is not prioritized. (3) theme-switch.tsx: initial state is light, so in dark mode the nav icon shows Moon until hydration. (4) saved() treats any non-empty stored value as an explicit choice, while the init script ignores unknown values; edge case only.
